description: A multi-source benchmark dataset for day-ahead electricity-price forecasting in the Guangdong spot market, published by Liu, Hongyan; Zhang, Qianqi; Tu, Tianyi; Wen, Fange; Lu, Liangji; Lan, Xiaping; Xu, Zeling; Zou, Yuntao, combines electricity-market, weather and external-driver tables for Guangdong day-ahead price forecasting. Coverage: Guangdong provincial market on a Beijing-time hourly grid; weather forecasts cover 21 cities. Exact observation dates are not stated. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page is available without a login, but Zenodo lists the files as restricted (access right: restricted); upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Keep as-of-bid features separate from ex-post and settlement columns; merging them without availability rules would leak future information. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
